title: 8 Marks of a Man Who's Actually Walking Humbly With God
caption:
Micah 6:8 doesn't call humility a personality trait. It calls it something you walk in, which means it shows up in how you actually handle a Tuesday, not just how you talk about God on Sunday.

It looks like taking correction without flinching, saying "I don't know" without it costing you anything, giving away credit as fast as you take blame. It looks like losing an argument and sleeping fine, asking questions in rooms you could dominate, being the same guy whether or not anyone's watching.

And it starts with getting on your own knees before you ask anyone else to. A real apology stops at the period. No "but" attached.
